office: Representative, Cagayan de Oro City 2nd District
role: District Representative · Cagayan de Oro City, 2nd District
profileLabel: Liberal on family law and gender; mixed on civil liberties (medium-low confidence)
summary: Cagayan de Oro 2nd District representative with 636 principal-authored bills. Authored recognition of foreign divorce decrees for Filipino spouses, equal treatment of legitimate and illegitimate children, removal of gender bias in adultery and concubinage, decriminalization of libel, a stronger Commission on Human Rights, penalties for false information, heavier penalties for alien drug traffickers, removal of the final withholding tax in capital markets and a REIT framework.
caveat: Only 18 bills surfaced of 636. Civil-liberties score nets libel decriminalization and human rights against false-information and drug-trafficking penalties.

economic.label: Center-right
economic.rationale: Authored removal of the final withholding tax in capital markets (+3), a REIT sponsor reinvestment framework (+2) and travel tax abolition (+1), against a national disease-control center and health emergency team (-2).
